pages.text: $(l)1. Steel$()$(br)Coal becomes $(item)coal coke$() in a coke oven. Hot air from a blast stove feeds a $(item)blast furnace$(), which melts crushed iron into molten steel. A casting basin turns it into $(item)steel ingots$().
$(l)2. Parts and machines$()$(br)Steel gives heavy plates, screws, casings and the $(item)steel mechanism$() that most machines need.
$(l)3. Electricity$()$(br)Generators turn rotation into power for motors, vats, the polarizer and the winding machine. Aluminium comes from electrolysis.
$(l)4. Oil$()$(br)Find a deposit, pump it with a pumpjack, refine it in a distillation tower into fuels, then burn them in $(item)engines$(), or turn them into plastic.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
